title: Creative AI Agents
tagline: An AI Agent swarm that handles day to day creative work, investing and guidance.
description: This project explores the intersection of conversational AI and tokenized systems. By integrating a token launcher within ElizaOS, users can earn tokens by engaging in meaningful conversations with Eliza, trading them with other users, or even purchasing them. These tokens can be used to influence Eliza's responses, unlocking new conversational pathways and personality traits, or even contribute to a shared narrative within the ElizaOS environment. This approach aims to create a more engaging and dynamic user experience, fostering a deeper connection between users and the AI through a system of rewards and personalized interactions.
how_its_made: This project combines a custom TypeScript ElizaOS framework, smart contracts on the Polygon blockchain, and a Next.js frontend.  The TypeScript framework manages conversational interactions and integrates with the token smart contracts, which govern token creation, distribution, and usage.  The Next.js frontend provides a user interface and bridges connections to external platforms.  We've integrated Warpcast, Discord, and Telegram APIs, enabling cross-platform interaction with ElizaOS and token management.  Image generation is powered by the FAL.AI API.  Users can earn tokens through platform engagement and use them to, for example, generate images or trigger Warpcast actions.  A custom Express.js API layer facilitates communication between the frontend, framework, and smart contracts (using ethers.js).  Key challenges included seamless cross-platform integration and maintaining data consistency.  We're actively developing new features, including additional platform integrations and expanded AI capabilities.
